svg.title: iGold — Connected Analytical Workspace
svg.desc: Conceptual iGold chart with green and red price candlesticks, seven thin colored XRay analytical traces shown unobtrusively behind price, and a Python Chart Studio for custom indicators, overlays and strategy scripts. Illustrative curves are not actual market data or proprietary analytics.

g.text: Seven subtle analytical traces on the chart
One research context across price, market information, XRay, and programmable analysis.
